The authors propose Truthful Text Summarization (TTS), an incentive-aligned pipeline designed to protect LLM-driven search summaries from strategic manipulation, hallucinations, and adversarial attacks. Unlike standard RAG pipelines, TTS filters sources before summarization by decomposing documents into atomic claims using a leave-one-out (LOO) construction. It employs a multi-task peer-prediction scoring rule that rewards informative corroboration over raw consensus, ensuring that truthful reporting maximizes a source's probability of inclusion.

Theoretical analysis demonstrates that TTS achieves informed and strong truthfulness, with guarantees that strengthen as the number of claims increases. Empirical evaluations on Natural Questions and ClashEval datasets show that TTS significantly improves answer accuracy and precision compared to majority-based baselines. Results indicate that TTS effectively separates reliable sources from deceptive or adversarial ones and remains robust against coordinated, uninformative behavior.

Lilly Nguyen and Phil De Carlos married at Texas Children’s Hospital on New Year’s Day to include their son, Lucas. Born via emergency C-section at 24 weeks gestation, Lucas remains in the NICU. De Carlos proposed to Nguyen in the NICU on December 15.

The Opportunity Project (TOP) is a nonprofit providing early education for children ages 1 to 5 in high-poverty areas of Wichita and Derby. A study by Wichita State University found that TOP graduates outperform comparable students in academics, social skills, and attendance through eighth grade. TOP utilizes a Reggio Emilia-inspired philosophy and supports families through scholarships, community resources, and "Parent Cafe" workshops. Funded by public and private sources, the organization aims to lift families out of poverty by educating both children and parents.

MIT and the Carnegie Institution for Science released a public dataset of nearly 61,000 measurements of over 1,600 nearby stars to help the general public and academics hunt for exoplanets. Gathered over 20 years by the W.M. Keck Observatory, the data includes an open-source software package and tutorial.

The NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture introduces a Hybrid Rendering model combining real-time ray tracing, rasterization, and AI. Key hardware advancements include RT Cores for accelerating Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) traversal and ray-triangle intersection, and Tensor Cores powering the NGX deep learning stack, which enables features like Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS), AI Super Rez, and InPainting.

Turing enhances video capabilities with updated NVENC and NVDEC units and introduces VirtualLink via USB Type-C to simplify VR headset connectivity. Other architectural improvements include NVLink for increased SLI bandwidth, Multi-View Rendering (MVR) for efficient stereo rendering, and Mesh Shading to reduce CPU draw call bottlenecks. Additionally, Variable Rate Shading (VRS) and Texture Space Shading (TSS) allow developers to dynamically optimize shading rates to improve performance and image quality.

On the 10th day of a government shutdown, the Trump administration began permanent "Reductions in Force" (RIFs) for federal workers. President Trump stated the layoffs would be "a lot" and target "Democrat-oriented" programs. Affected agencies include Treasury, Health and Human Services, Commerce, Education, Energy, EPA, Homeland Security, Housing and Urban Development, and Interior. While the administration and Republicans blame Democrats for the shutdown, Democratic senators have refused funding plans that do not extend Affordable Care Act tax credits. Federal employee unions have filed lawsuits to fight the layoffs.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2018. Consolidated net sales for the second quarter of 2018 were $52.886 billion, a 39% increase over Q2 2017, with net income rising to $2.534 billion. Growth was driven by increased unit sales in North America and International segments, and increased customer usage in AWS. The company acquired Ring Inc. in April 2018 for approximately $853 million. As of June 30, 2018, total assets were $134.1 billion and total stockholders' equity was $34.995 billion.

Vladimir Guerrero Jr., a Toronto Blue Jays star born in Montreal, is the son of Hall of Famer Vladimir Guerrero Sr. and Riquelma Ramos. He is married to Nathalie Guerrero, and they have two daughters, Vlaimel and Vlaishel. His family has deep baseball ties, including brother Pablo, half-brother Vladi Miguel, uncles Wilton and Julio, and cousins Gabriel and Gregory. Additionally, Hall of Famer Pedro Martinez is his godfather.

Unico Properties is automating the elevators of Seattle's 103-year-old Smith Tower to improve safety, reliability, and accessibility. While most operators will no longer be required by mid-2018, the company will retain at least one operator to preserve the building's historic significance. Completed in 1914, the 42-story tower was once the tallest building west of the Mississippi River.

The court affirmed a judgment in favor of Catharine Heilmann, ruling that deposits made by Diedrick Grafing in his name "in trust for Catharine Heilmann" created a valid trust. The court held that the depositor's retention of the bank books and his drawing of interest during his lifetime were not inconsistent with the intention to create a trust. Furthermore, the payment of a portion of the principal to the beneficiary was viewed as a recognition of her title rather than a loan. The court determined the transaction was not a testamentary disposition because the defendant's interest vested at the time of deposit.

House Democrats Nancy Pelosi and Elijah Cummings mistakenly cited a fake Michael Flynn Twitter account during a news conference. Both later acknowledged the error. The New York Times also initially cited the unverified account before correcting its story.

The 123 reversal strategy is a technical analysis tool using a three-swing price formation to predict trend reversals. A bearish pattern occurs in an uptrend when a price swing fails to make a higher high and subsequently breaks below a previous low. A bullish pattern, or 123 bottom, occurs in a downtrend when a swing fails to make a lower low and breaks above a previous high.

Trading rules involve entering a trade at the close of the breakout bar at point 2. Stop losses are placed above or below point 3, or beyond point 1 in volatile markets. Profit targets are estimated by measuring the pattern or managed via partial profits and trailing stops. The strategy is applicable to stocks, forex, commodities, and Bitcoin. Backtests on gold (GLD) showed promising results, with bullish reversals performing better than bearish ones.

This disclosure describes techniques for cooperative monitoring networks that unite multiple existing monitoring systems to detect and respond to events on a neighborhood or regional scale. A system can evaluate a detected event against a set of rules to form a cooperative network, allowing nearby monitoring systems to share data, such as alerts and camera images, to track entities of interest or coordinate responses.

The system includes monitoring system control units, user devices, a monitoring application server, and a central alarm station server. It can distinguish between "property-specific" events and "cooperative" events to identify neighborhood-wide malfunctions (e.g., power failures or signal jamming) or to reduce false alarms. Cooperative networks can be modified dynamically—adding or removing participants based on the location and timing of events or machine learning route predictions—and can expand in a cascading manner to notify neighbors or paid responders.

Hajime is a resilient IoT malware that creates a decentralized botnet using peer-to-peer communication, making it harder to stop than the command-and-control based Mirai. While Mirai has been used for massive DDoS attacks, Hajime's purpose remains unknown, though it has infected approximately 100,000 devices. Both target poorly secured devices, but Hajime primarily infects ARM chip architecture. Experts suggest patching vulnerable devices is the only way to stop these persistent threats.

OpenAI reached a $500 billion valuation after employees sold approximately $6.6 billion in stock to institutional investors. This increase follows rapid revenue growth, with $4.3 billion generated in the first half of 2025. While the valuation strengthens OpenAI's market position against rivals, the company faces ongoing scrutiny regarding profitability, governance, and regulation.

The UCLA High Post Rub Offense is a flexible system utilizing inside and outside attacks, often employing a 1-4 set to counter pressure defenses. It is suitable for teams lacking a traditional low post player, as it leverages a point guard's ability to post up and a high post player's passing and shooting. The offense consists of two primary phases: the high post rub cut and ball reversal down screens. Success depends on precise execution, court spacing, and the ability of players to read defensive tactics and apply specific counters.

Trump's threat of 100% tariffs on China has caused US stock indexes and the S&P 500 to slump. While gold rallied, mining stocks and silver did not follow, suggesting a potential larger decline. The USD Index shows bullish patterns, and stocks face bearish signals. The author compares these conditions to 2008.

Assuming the presidency under extraordinary circumstances, the speaker pledges to be the President of all people and to lead with openness and honesty. He intends to meet with Congress to discuss national priorities and pledges a sincere search for peace globally. He calls for national healing following Watergate and reaffirms his promise to uphold the Constitution.

Andrew Lo discusses capital budgeting, emphasizing that Net Present Value (NPV) is the recommended method because it accounts for scale and maximizes shareholder value. He contrasts NPV with three common but less reliable alternatives:

*   **Payback Period:** Measures the time to recover an initial investment. It is often used due to "career risk" or liquidity concerns but is shortsighted as it ignores cash flows after the payback period.
*   **Profitability Index:** A ratio of gross present value to initial investment. While similar to NPV, it ignores scale, making it unsuitable for ranking mutually exclusive projects.
*   **Internal Rate of Return (IRR):** The break-even discount rate. It is widely used in bond pricing and private equity but can be problematic because it may result in multiple solutions, no real solution, or incorrect rankings for loans.

Lo concludes by noting that while NPV is the financial standard, practitioners must also consider political, social, and cultural factors.

Additional work is needed on Indian reservations to teach Indians to earn a living based on natural aptitude, diversified industries, and English proficiency. Government officials dealing with Indians should be well-paid and held to high conduct standards. Scientific aid has improved farming through new plants and crops. The author recommends Smithsonian plans to preserve records of vanishing races and animals. Washington, D.C., should serve as a national model for sanitary legislation, charitable systems, and labor laws. Finally, the author suggests perfecting the 1893 safety-appliance law for railway employees.

The speaker discusses a game against Dallas, noting that while they had success in the first game by getting the puck in deep, they struggled in the neutral zone during the second. The speaker emphasizes the need for consistency in "dirty work," winning one-on-one battles, and maintaining their effectiveness as a road team.

Using data from the VDAART cohort, this study examined the association between the gut microbiome and children's neurodevelopment from years one to three. Results indicate that the maternal gut microbiome is more relevant for predicting first-year neurodevelopment (ASQ-Y1) than the infant or child gut microbiomes. The predictive power of maternal and infant microbiomes diminishes by year two and is absent by year three. Additionally, the study found that while maternal and infant microbiomes share similar taxa, these taxa may play different roles in neurodevelopment.

An email chain from July to November 2000 consists of multiple forwards of a message from Amy Bruce, a 7-year-old with lung cancer and a brain tumor. The message claims the Make A Wish Foundation will donate 7 cents for every name on the list and urges recipients to forward the email.

Troll Cakes is a New York City-based bakery and detective agency that sends chocolate chip brownie cakes decorated with internet insults to trolls. Services cost $35 for shipping or $60 if the company tracks the address. Additionally, a $30 "Tiny Hands Special" sends a Trump tweet to the White House.

Travis Zajac described the opposing goalie as fast, quick on rebounds, and active in playing pucks. He stated the team needs more traffic and pucks to the net to secure their first win, drawing confidence from previous series wins against Florida and the Rangers.

An individual discussed entering a Stanley Cup final with five minutes remaining, noting it as a learning process. They addressed a mistake made by holding the puck too long, acknowledged the impact of inactivity, and expressed confidence in their ability to help the team.

Observations of the elliptical galaxy Centaurus A show 14 of its 16 satellite galaxies orbiting on a common plane. This contradicts the lambda cold dark matter model, which predicts random, spherical orbits. While astrophysicist Marcel Pawlowski suggests this may indicate flaws in current cosmological models, others argue the phenomenon could be a statistical fluke or a quirk of dark matter filaments.

Offensive corner kicks are planned restarts requiring a set play, a target, and a proper service kick. Common types include Far Post (targeting the best header), Near Post (exploiting undefended areas), Medium (targeting the goal area or penalty mark), Top-of-the-Arc (targeting undefended space), Short (drawing defenders away), Skip Header (flicking the ball to the back post), and Direct Score (curving the ball into the goal). Coaches select takers and targets based on skill and implement these plays through progressive drilling. Additional tactical considerations include the Floated-ball Corner, wind adjustments, and goalkeeper challenges.

Researchers developed and validated a Fluorescent Immuno-Lectin Assay (FILA) to investigate lubricin glycoforms in the plasma and synovial fluid (SF) of osteoarthritis (OA) patients. Results showed that SF lubricin has higher concentrations and more truncated glycosylation (Tn-antigen) than plasma lubricin, which exhibits higher sialylation. In plasma, OA patients showed significantly decreased levels of SNA-detected glycoforms compared to controls. Additionally, plasma lubricin sialylation and complexity positively correlated with BMI, while sialylation negatively correlated with age.

A study of 121 community-dwelling adults aged 60 and older evaluated pneumococcal carriage and transmission. Using saliva qPCR targeting the *piaB* gene, researchers found that 22.3% of individuals were colonized at least once, with an overall sample positivity rate of 4.8%. The study found no clear evidence of adult-to-adult transmission within households. Instead, pneumococcal acquisition was strongly associated with frequent contact with children under 10 years old, particularly those aged 24–59 months. The findings suggest that adult PCV immunization primarily protects adults exposed to children rather than reducing onward transmission to other adults.

On June 10, 2015, Tesla Motors, Inc. and Tesla Motors Netherlands B.V. entered into an ABL Credit Agreement with several banks for a senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility of up to $500.0 million, potentially increasing to $750.0 million. The agreement includes a $100.0 million letter of credit subfacility and a $40.0 million swingline loan subfacility for working capital and general corporate purposes. Michael Barnard asserts that politicians will be held accountable for climate change ignorance as extreme weather events lead more voters to accept global warming. He predicts migration from affected areas will shift voting patterns away from Republicans toward Democrats, eventually resulting in Republicans being voted out if they do not change.

Europe will launch the Sentinel-3B satellite on Wednesday via a Russian Rockot launcher to monitor Earth's oceans, coastal areas, rivers, lakes, and wildfires. Part of the EU and ESA-funded Copernicus constellation, it will work with Sentinel-3A to provide continuous environmental data. The "Double Stack" offense counters the Triangle & Two defense, which uses three zone players and two "chasers" to deny shooters. By positioning shooters behind mid-post players, the offense creates space and head-start advantages. Shooters can pop out for shots, curl, fade, or back cut based on the chaser's movement. The system utilizes various entries, base screens, and side screens, requiring strong execution, coordination, and defensive recognition.

The GHCB protocol enables communication between an SEV-ES/SNP guest and a hypervisor. When a guest encounters a Non-Automatic Exit (NAE) event, it triggers a #VC exception, updates the GHCB fields, and executes a VMGEXIT. The hypervisor then processes the request based on the `SW_EXITCODE`, updates the GHCB save state, and resumes the guest.

Key features include:
*   **SEV-SNP Enhancements:** Includes a Secrets Page for environment communication, SNP Guest Request APIs for firmware interaction, and AP Creation for vCPU management.
*   **Memory and State Management:** Supports Page State Changes (private/shared), Secure AVIC backing pages, and a shared buffer for MMIO and IOIO operations.
*   **Restricted Injection:** Uses a #HV doorbell page with `PendingEvent` and `NoEoiRequired` fields to manage interrupt delivery and EOI assists.
*   **Booting and Termination:** Defines specific protocols for SMP booting (AP Jump Tables/AP Creation) and guest termination requests.

The AEGEAN study evaluated apixaban adherence in subjects with atrial fibrillation, comparing a Primary SOC group to an Additional Educational Program. At 24 weeks, mean adherence (91.64% vs. 91.88%) and persistence (91.7% vs. 91.3%) showed no significant differences between groups. This trend continued at 48 weeks, with mean adherence remaining comparable across the Primary SOC, Secondary SOC, and Continued Additional Educational Program groups.

Safety endpoints, including adverse events and bleeding, were similar across groups. A total of 24 deaths were reported over 48 weeks. The study concluded that while adherence and persistence were high, the proactive educational program provided no additional benefits.

A phase 2 clinical trial presented by Seattle Children's Research Institute found that adding Abatacept to standard regimens reduced grade III-IV acute graft-versus-host disease from 32 percent to 3 percent in patients receiving mismatched unrelated donor stem cell transplants. This resulted in improved overall and disease-free survival at one year post-transplant without increasing disease relapse or major uncontrolled infections.

Stoke City, currently 13th, faces relegation-threatened Hull City on Saturday. Defender Geoff Cameron described the match as a "must-win" to end Stoke's five-game winless streak. Hull is 17th and has not won an away league game since August.

He claimed to have settled multiple international conflicts, including disputes between India and Pakistan, and Azerbaijan and Armenia, while working toward peace in the Middle East and Ukraine.

Childs Farm Baby Moisturiser, a budget cream made from natural ingredients, has been praised by users for treating eczema and psoriasis. This study analyzed over 8 million patients using Truveta EHR data to compare the 2009 and 2021 CKD-EPI GFR equations, the latter of which removed race adjustments. Results showed significant staging discordance, particularly for Black patients; the 2021 equation identified CKD earlier for 24% of Black patients compared to 0.7% of non-Black patients. Multivariate analysis indicated Black patients were 126 times more likely to have an increased CKD stage using the 2021 equation. No significant associations were found between the included social determinants of health and increased CKD staging.

Legal experts Shane Kilcommins and Eimear Spain have criticized the Communications (Retention of Data) Bill 2017 for omitting two Murray Report recommendations: the requirement for High Court judge authorization to protect journalists' sources and the creation of an independent monitoring body to oversee service providers. While the bill increases prior judicial authorization requirements, experts questioned the effectiveness of its retrospective High Court reviews.
Clinical trials indicate that orforglipron and another oral GLP-1 drug help people with obesity lose weight, offering an alternative to injections that require needles and refrigeration.

Dr. Michael Bottros at the Washington University Pain Management Center uses spinal cord stimulator implants to treat chronic back pain. The procedure involves inserting insulated wire leads into the epidural space to block pain signals to the brain. Deanna Conley, who previously required a walker or wheelchair, experienced significant improvement after receiving a permanent implant. Dr. Bottros reports that nearly all of his 40 to 50 recent patients have seen remarkable results.

Rory McKelvie, a 19-year-old from Biggar, Lanarkshire, was found dead in his sleep. Before his death, McKelvie shared on social media that he received little support from doctors, who told him he was not "bad enough" and to return when closer to a "breaking point." Site Selection magazine ranked the Wilmington — Clinton County micropolitan 64th among the "Top 100 Micropolitans" in the U.S. Clinton County submitted four projects via the Clinton County Port Authority, resulting in $70 million in investment, 150 new jobs, and 400 retained jobs.

Enron Corp. is facing imminent bankruptcy following the collapse of a merger with Dynegy Inc. and a credit downgrade to junk status. This has led to Enron's suspension from several European energy exchanges, including the EEX and Nord Pool, and its barring from trading power futures in Australia. 

The company's downfall has caused market volatility in Europe, where it held a significant share of electricity trading. Various units and assets are under review for sale, including the UK's Wessex Water and the Teesside power station. Arsene Wenger aims to integrate attacking players Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, Henrikh Mkhitaryan, Mesut Ozil, and Alexandre Lacazette into Arsenal's lineup while improving the team's defensive balance. Edmonton police charged 62-year-old blogger Barry Kent Winters with wilfully promoting hatred against an identifiable group. Winters' blogs contained racist and hateful content targeting various groups and public figures, including fantasies of violence. Following a 13-month investigation, the rare charge was laid with the deputy attorney general's consent. Courts ordered the blogs' removal as a condition of Winters' release.

The $7 billion Strategic National Stockpile is a government repository of medicines and supplies used for bioterrorism, nuclear attacks, pandemics, and public health emergencies. Created in 1999, the program's mission has expanded from chemical and biological threats to include natural disasters. The Trump administration plans to shift oversight of the $575 million program from the CDC to the Department of Health and Human Services' office of the assistant secretary for preparedness and response (ASPR) to streamline decision-making. While proponents argue this will increase efficiency and visibility, critics and some members of Congress worry the move could politicize procurement, disrupt state and local distribution relationships, and risk the delivery of lifesaving supplies.

Paula and John Larison appealed a summary judgment granted to the Public Water Supply District # 1 of Andrew County after Mrs. Larison was injured when a water meter lid slid, causing her to fall into the well. The Larisons alleged the Water District was negligent in securing the lid, had knowledge of a dangerous condition, or was liable under res ipsa loquitur.

The Court of Appeals reversed the summary judgment regarding operator negligence, ruling that a genuine issue of material fact exists as to whether the employee negligently replaced the lid. However, the court affirmed summary judgment on the claim that the Water District knew or should have known of the dangerous condition, citing a lack of evidence. It also affirmed the dismissal of the res ipsa loquitur claim, finding the Water District did not have exclusive control over the meter lid.

This population-wide study used SAEFVIC spontaneous reports and POLAR general practice data to analyze the association between COVID-19 vaccinations and audiovestibular conditions between January 2021 and March 2023. Results indicated an increased relative incidence of vertigo following mRNA vaccines and an increased relative incidence of tinnitus following both mRNA and adenovirus vector vaccines within a 42-day risk window. No increased relative incidence of hearing loss was observed for any vaccine type.

Proposed in the mid-1960s and experimentally discovered in 2012, the Higgs mechanism explains how gauge bosons and fermions acquire mass. Because mass terms typically break local gauge invariance, the mechanism uses spontaneous symmetry breaking. In a toy model, a complex scalar field with a potential where $\mu^2 < 0$ creates a non-zero vacuum expectation value, resulting in a massive gauge boson and a massive scalar field, while the Goldstone boson is absorbed. In the Standard Model, this is generalized to $SU(2) \times U(1)$ gauge groups using a complex doublet field. This process generates masses for the $W^+$, $W^-$, and $Z$ bosons—proportional to the coupling strength and vacuum expectation value—while the photon remains massless and a physical Higgs boson remains.

Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya BCom (Hons) third semester students were mistakenly given Corporate Accounts papers instead of Corporate Law papers on Monday, delaying the exam by 30 minutes. While the Corporate Accounts exam is scheduled for December 18, university officials denied a leak occurred. Gold steadied below $1,250 an ounce on Monday following its largest weekly drop since May. Markets are awaiting a U.S. Federal Reserve policy meeting and expected interest rate hike. Meanwhile, money managers significantly reduced net long positions in gold and silver contracts.

Education groups in China are formed to combat the "siphon effect," where resources migrate from disadvantaged areas to prestigious schools. These groups consist of a "core school" and "ordinary schools" that collaborate to share resources, improve teacher competence, and enhance student development, thereby reducing educational disparities and "school picking" anxiety. However, challenges include the potential loss of non-core schools' individuality, difficulties in applying advanced philosophies due to varying ability levels, and management burdens on core schools. Suggested improvements include establishing democratic decision-making committees, strengthening teacher rotation and digital resource sharing, and increasing government financial and policy support.

During Fire Prevention month in October, state fire departments are promoting the theme “Every Second counts –know two ways out,” urging people to identify multiple exits and avoid blocking doors or windows. Officials are reinforcing safety messages for children, advising families to exit immediately when alarms sound, stay outside, and rehearse home fire drills.

The Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) protocol enables communication between a hypervisor and SEV-ES/SNP guests. The hypervisor sets the GHCB guest physical address (GPA) via VMCB offset 0x00a0. Guests negotiate protocol versions and establish page table encryption bits using CPUID instructions and MSR 0xc001_0130.

Non-Automatic Exits (NAE) trigger #VC exceptions, leading the guest to populate the GHCB and issue a VMGEXIT. The hypervisor then processes the request based on the SW_EXITCODE. Supported NAE events include IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, #NPF/MMIO access, Page State Changes, and SNP-specific requests (Guest Request, Extended Guest Request, AP Creation, and #HV doorbell page).

For SEV-SNP guests, the #HV doorbell page facilitates interrupt delivery via a "PendingEvent" field and "NoEoiRequired" assist, allowing the host to signal interrupts or non-maskable events. Additionally, the protocol manages SMP booting through AP Reset Hold or SNP AP Creation, and provides mechanisms for Secure AVIC and termination requests.

Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days offer discounts on nearly all Kindle models. Available options include the Colorsoft and Colorsoft Signature Edition for color content, the second-generation Kindle Scribe for digital note-taking, the 12th Generation Paperwhite and its Signature edition, and the base Kindle for budget users. Kids-specific versions of the Colorsoft and Paperwhite are also available.
The court denied John Whitfield's application for a writ of error coram nobis to vacate a March 9, 1992, decision, as the appellant failed to establish ineffective assistance of appellate counsel.

Adidas and Refinery 29 created the "Boost the Nation" collection, featuring one custom UltraBOOST X running shoe for each of the 50 states. Designed by female artists, the shoes are being auctioned to benefit the international charity Women Win. Examples include Georgia's peach-themed shoe, Wisconsin's cheese design, and Texas's blue topaz theme.

The court unanimously affirmed the judgment convicting Vu Ngo of three counts of first-degree robbery. The court declined to review the defendant's claim regarding a peremptory challenge and rejected the argument that his hospital detention was unlawful, ruling that police had reasonable suspicion to justify his detention for questioning and identification.

Britain's FTSE 100 closed 0.4 percent higher on Wednesday following the formal triggering of Brexit, boosted by a weaker pound and gains in mining firms and LSE shares. The mid-cap index rose 0.1 percent. 3I Group shares soared 5.7 percent after a Morgan Stanley upgrade, while gold miners and AA saw declines.

On February 16, 2001, Jeff Dasovich sent an email to several recipients, including Sandra McCubbin and Susan J. Mara, regarding a confidential message from Ken Lay to Senator Brulte. The email included a summary of proposed legislation to address California's electricity crisis, focusing on increasing supply, decreasing demand, establishing a competitive retail market, and returning investor-owned utilities to solvency. It also detailed credit risk concerns regarding the Department of Water Resources (DWR) and proposed legislative or regulatory fixes. A delivery failure notification was subsequently sent to Dasovich because the address hgovenar@mail.acom2.com was unknown.

This study used 3T MRI and the PINGU deep-learning algorithm to investigate perivascular space (PVS) burden in 467 people with various epilepsy subtypes (TLE-HS, TLE-NEG, ETLE, and IGE) compared to 473 healthy controls. Results showed that all epilepsy subtypes had significantly higher PVS volume fractions in the basal ganglia compared to controls, even after correcting for age and sex. No significant differences were found in the white matter or in association with the duration of illness. The TLE-HS group exhibited a negative PVS asymmetry in the white matter, with larger volumes on the contralateral side. The authors conclude that PVS in the basal ganglia are enlarged in people with epilepsy, though longitudinal studies are required to determine if this is a cause or effect of seizures.

On June 16, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation announced that David M. Shannon, Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer and Secretary, will retire at the end of the calendar year. Brian E. Cabrera, Senior Vice President and General Counsel, will lead the legal team upon Shannon's retirement, and NVIDIA will recruit a leader for human resources.

This work presents the formal modeling, verification, and correct-by-construction synthesis of a voter unit for a synchronous N-modular redundant measurement system used in avionics. The voter unit selects a reliable output value from redundant input units by identifying and isolating transient and permanent faults using a noise-resilient voting algorithm.

The system is designed as a state transition system with requirements (R1–R16) covering fault identification, isolation, and output generation. It utilizes a "risky_count" to distinguish between transient and permanent faults and maintains a "validity_status" (valid, un_id, or not_valid) to indicate output reliability.

Implemented using the Rocq interactive theorem prover, the design leverages higher-order logics and dependent types to ensure invariants are maintained during state transitions. The verified code is extractable to OCaml, Haskell, or Scheme, allowing designers to configure reliability parameters such as the noise threshold and persistence limit.

Dr. Thomas Wilson Ikubese, convener of the YesWeFit Revolution and 2019 presidential aspirant, joined the Alliance for New Nigeria (ANN) on May 29, 2018. This decision followed the Nigerian Intervention Movement's adoption of the ANN. Ikubese, who previously left the National Conscience Party, urged other young aspirants and supporters to join the ANN to challenge President Buhari's administration.

AMD's Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine facilitates moving memory pages between different performance tiers to optimize system performance. It allows for the migration of pages actively used by DMA devices via the `PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO` command and the migration of SNP-protected guest pages via the `PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST` command.

The system operates using a ring buffer interface managed by a driver, supporting batches of up to 128 pages per command. TMPM requires IOMMU enablement and uses specific states, such as "Pre-Migration," to handle SNP guest pages. The engine includes capabilities for firmware reloading, error handling through status codes and Machine Check Architecture (MCA), and various interrupt sources to signal completion or errors.

Doctors emphasize spreading awareness about eye cancer symptoms to improve early detection and treatment, as most cases are currently detected too late. Ocular oncology experts note a scarcity of specialized facilities and trained doctors in India. Retinoblastoma, common in children under five, can be treated to save eyesight if detected early.

Education is categorized into formal, non-formal, and informal learning. Digitalization has transformed these processes, shifting conventional teacher-based education toward personalized, student-based online learning. In design education, digital tools and online informal platforms—such as synchronous workshops and asynchronous courses—enable rapid skill acquisition in computational and parametric design. While these platforms offer advantages like global accessibility, multi-disciplinary collaboration, and practical application, they face limitations including economic barriers, a lack of integration into formal academic transcripts, and potential social isolation. The study concludes that online informal education fosters personalized learning and complements formal design education, though it increases professional competitiveness.

This research developed an integrated environmental education model based on the theory of multiple intelligences for students in Thailand's expanded educational opportunity schools. Using a three-phase action and development research design, the study analyzed environmental issues in Nakhon Pathom, identifying agricultural chemicals and indiscriminate waste disposal as primary pollutants. 

The resulting model achieved an efficiency of 81.51/82.11, exceeding the 80/80 criteria. Evaluation of 30 students showed a significant increase in academic achievement from a pre-test average of 5.90 to a post-test average of 24.63, with students reporting high satisfaction. The study concludes that integrating practical, learner-centered environmental education helps address gaps in student awareness and participation, aligning with UN Sustainable Development Goal 4.

A seven-judge Supreme Court Bench ruled that re-promulgating ordinances is a fraud on the Constitution and a subversion of democratic processes. The court held that the President's and Governor's satisfaction under Articles 123 and 213 is subject to judicial review and that laying ordinances before the legislature is a mandatory constitutional obligation.

A University of Surrey study finds solar energy is now the cheapest large-scale power source globally, outcompeting fossil fuels and wind. Falling lithium-ion battery prices have made solar-plus-storage systems cost-effective and reliable. While perovskite cells could increase output, challenges like grid congestion persist. Experts suggest smart grids, AI forecasting, and sustained policy support are essential for a stable transition.

An 1893 notice from Mr. Kung-i criticizes foreign religions for spreading falsehoods, abandoning ancestral sacrifices, and practicing hypocrisy. He accuses religious leaders of greed and deception, demanding they depart or face attack on the 7th of the third moon. Separately, Mr. Heard informed Mr. Gresham that Confucian followers in Seoul petitioned the King to exterminate the Tong Hâk for professing false doctrines.

A non-inverting comparator with hysteresis uses a voltage reference and a two-resistor network. The output is low when VIN is less than VREF and switches to high when VIN exceeds the VIN1 threshold. The output switches back to low when VIN drops below VIN2. Hysteresis is the difference between VIN1 and VIN2.

On January 26, 2015, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K with the SEC to announce its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2014, via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The bull market signal strategy involves selling the S&P 500 after a 20% drop from its all-time high and buying after 18 consecutive closes above the 200-day SMA. A backtest from 1927 to the present showed 12 signals, a 7.24% CAGR, and a 60% maximum drawdown. This strategy avoids false signals and outperforms the Golden Cross in total performance and market time, though not on a risk-adjusted basis.

St. George welcomed an 11-person delegation from its sister city, Ibigawa, Japan, for the 41st annual St. George Marathon. The group, including four runners and Vice Mayor Sunao Isaji, attended local receptions and a luncheon. St. George will send a similar delegation to the 30th annual Ibigawa Marathon on November 12.

Ola and Uber drivers in Delhi-NCR threatened a one-day strike over low fares and a 25% commission, demanding fares increase from Rs 6 to Rs 20 per km. While the Sarvodaya Drivers' Association planned a protest march to the CM's residence, the Delhi High Court permanently enjoined unions from disrupting services. The Delhi Autorickshaw Sangh and Delhi Pradesh Taxi Union stated they will not participate.

Rain Bird's IP 68 compliant, waterproof WPX battery-operated controller is designed for areas lacking mains power. Available in 1, 2, 4, or 6 zone models, it features an LCD screen, Contractor Rapid Programming™, and automatic zone-stacking. It operates for one to two years using 9v batteries.

During a line change, Matt made a play to Teemu, who passed to the speaker. After returning the puck to Teemu and driving to the net, the speaker scored on an open net. The speaker's line, including Getzlaf and Perry, remained disciplined to finish the game.

A study published in Nature Ecology & Evolution found that endotherms (birds and mammals) adapt to temperature changes 2-3 times faster than ectotherms (reptiles and amphibians). Analyzing 270 million years of data, researchers attributed this to internal body temperature regulation and the ability to control the temperature of developing offspring. However, lead author Jonathan Rolland noted it is unclear if these traits will aid survival against rapid modern climate change, pollution, and habitat loss.

This document specifies communication protocols between a hypervisor and SEV-ES/SNP guests. Key features include:

*   **VMPL Management:** Guests can request VMPL level changes via NAE events, requiring the hypervisor to update the VMSA and GHCB.
*   **SEV-TIO:** Enables guests to bind to trusted devices using TIO Guest Requests, utilizing data pages for measurements, certificates, and TDISP attestation reports.
*   **Secure AVIC:** Manages guest-owned APIC state using private backing pages that the hypervisor must keep present in the NPT.
*   **Termination & Errors:** Defines a termination request NAE event with reason codes and a mechanism for handling unsupported NAEs via #VC handlers.
*   **Booting & APs:** Details challenges in SMP booting due to register encryption, outlining methods for AP initialization and the use of AP jump tables or the SNP AP Creation feature for vCPU hotplug.
*   **Interrupts & NMIs:** Specifies NMI injection requirements and the use of a #HV doorbell page for host-to-guest notifications. This page uses `PendingEvent` and `NoEoiRequired` fields to emulate APIC behavior and manage interrupt delivery.
*   **Other:** Supports hardware debug register virtualization but excludes SMM and nested virtualization.

Kuwait's oil minister stated that cleanup of a crude oil spill in southern waters near Ras al-Zour will finish this week. While the cause and magnitude are under investigation, the Khajfi Joint Operations implemented an emergency plan and confirmed its facilities are safe.

This augmented reality system for image-guided surgery uses head-mounted devices to overlay virtual images of tools and patient anatomy onto a healthcare professional's view. A tracking device on the head-mounted device uses a camera to monitor a patient marker and tool marker, allowing a computer processor to determine location and orientation without triangulation. If the primary tracking device loses its line of sight, the system can incorporate data from additional tracking devices, such as those on other head-mounted devices or stationary units, to maintain the augmented reality image.

After nine years of growth driven by corporate profits and deregulation, investors are now concerned that a strong economy and rising wages may lead to higher inflation. This shift has caused stocks to tumble and Treasury yields to surge, as investors fear central banks may end the era of cheap money and low interest rates used since 2009 to stimulate growth.

Market corrections (10-20% drops) occur annually on average, with 80% not becoming bear markets (drops over 20%). Historically, corrections average a 13.5% decline lasting 54 days, while bear markets average a 33% drop and last about a year. Despite these regular declines, the S&P 500 achieved positive returns in 27 of 36 years from 1980 to 2015. Warren Buffett suggests that productivity and population growth will continue driving American economic wealth.

The TPS7H500x-SP series consists of radiation-hardened, fixed-frequency, peak current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. They support various topologies, including buck, flyback, forward, push-pull, and full-bridge, with switching frequencies up to 2 MHz.

Key technical features include:
*   **Outputs:** Primary switching outputs (OUTA/OUTB) and synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB) have roughly 150-mA peak current capability, necessitating external gate drives.
*   **Programmability:** Users can program dead times, leading edge blank times, and maximum duty cycles (50%, 75%, or 100%) via external resistors and pin configurations.
*   **Protection:** The devices feature a pulse skipping mode for high-frequency operation, a hiccup mode for overcurrent protection triggered at 1.05 V on the CS_ILIM pin, an external FAULT pin for additional protections, and thermal shutdown at 175°C.
*   **Control:** Stability is maintained via programmable slope compensation (RSC pin) and frequency compensation (Type 2A or 2B).
*   **Operation:** The controllers operate from a 4 V to 14 V input supply.

The author advocates for government supervision rather than ownership of business to ensure equality of opportunity. He proposes amending laws to permit beneficial business combinations sanctioned by the Interstate Commerce Commission, arguing that current laws are unenforceable and counterproductive. Additionally, he suggests the National Government implement graduated inheritance and income taxes to distribute the tax burden more equitably.

Apple Inc.'s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2018, reports net sales of $61.137 billion and net income of $13.822 billion. Net sales increased 16% year-over-year, driven by iPhone, Services, and Other Products. The company spent $23.5 billion on share repurchases and paid $3.2 billion in dividends during the quarter. Financial highlights include a gross margin percentage of 38.3% and the impact of the U.S. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act on its effective tax rate and deferred tax liabilities.

Two teens from Mill Park were arrested and a third person remains at large following a police pursuit of a stolen Subaru that began in Frankston. The 18-year-old man was hospitalized after being bitten by a police dog.

Saudi Arabia has selected international oil companies for three natural gas projects totaling approximately $25 billion in investment. Exxon Mobil will lead Core Venture 2 (Red Sea), with Enron and Occidental Petroleum as partners. Core Venture 1 (South Ghawar) involves Exxon Mobil, Royal Dutch/Shell, BP, and Phillips Petroleum, while Core Venture 3 (Shaybah) includes Shell, TotalFinaElf, and Conoco. Leaders for Ventures 1 and 3 are expected by June 5.

Separately, reports indicate California may lose over 40% of its long-term power contracts due to a failed bond deal, while investors are selling options amid expectations of a flat market.

Sam Bankman-Fried (SBF) co-founded the crypto trading firm Alameda Research and the exchange FTX. By early 2022, FTX was valued at $32 billion, but it filed for bankruptcy on November 11, 2022, following a liquidity crisis and a run on customer funds. SBF, Gary Wang, Caroline Ellison, and Nishad Singh were charged with crimes including fraud and money laundering. 

Investigations revealed that SBF directed the diversion of billions in FTX customer funds to Alameda for venture investments, real estate, and political donations. Singh and Wang wrote code allowing Alameda to maintain a nearly limitless line of credit and negative balances. The collapse was accelerated by the leak of Alameda's balance sheet, which showed heavy reliance on FTT, a token minted by FTX. Post-bankruptcy CEO John Ray cited a complete failure of corporate controls, noting the absence of an independent board, accounting department, or CFO.

Penn State University is banning student-led trips for the Outing Club, Nittany Grotto Caving Club, and Nittany Divers SCUBA Club due to risk assessments. University officials cited remote environments and poor emergency service access as safety concerns. While the university will offer its own outdoor program, student leaders claim they were not consulted.

Google released Android 8.0 Oreo in August, featuring under-the-hood refinements like Notification Dots, Smart Text Selection, Notification Snoozing, and an Autofill Framework. A key feature is Picture-in-Picture (PiP) Mode, which allows supported apps—such as Google Chrome, Maps, and WhatsApp—to run in a floating window for enhanced multitasking. PiP must be enabled by developers and can be managed in the system settings.

In *Thomas Henderson v. Alex. Beaton et als.*, the court addressed a trespass action to try title and partition of land. The court ruled that an 1839 instrument from Mastín Latham to William F. Henderson was an absolute, unconditional deed rather than an executory contract, as the consideration involved past services and the partition clause was a provision for speedy division, not a condition subsequent. Consequently, the defense of stale demand was inapplicable. The court further rejected the defendants' statute of limitations defenses: the ten-year bar was incomplete; the five-year bar failed due to lack of evidence of tax payments; and the three-year bar failed because the possession was naked and lacked color of title. The judgment was reversed and remanded.

Gifts to the Annual Fund support efforts to protect the rule of law, build independent courts and legal institutions, and advance representation in the legal system by eliminating bias and expanding access to justice. Donors receive a sticker and magnet set.

Attempts to suspend the embargo by negotiating with Great Britain and France failed, as France did not respond and Great Britain rejected the proposal. Consequently, the embargo remains in effect. The administration reports that seaport defenses are being completed, 103 gun-boats are being built, and military recruiting is underway. Internal arms production has increased to offset foreign supply difficulties. Relations with Indian tribes are improving, while negotiations with Spain are paused. Financially, the treasury has reduced the funded debt, leaving a surplus for Congress to consider allocating toward internal improvements. The author concludes by expressing gratitude to Congress and the citizens upon retiring from office.

Ukraine has partnered with the Bitfury Group to place all government electronic data on a blockchain platform. This project, described as the largest of its kind, will begin with a pilot program late this year focusing on public services, state registers, energy, public health, and social security before expanding to all areas, including cyber security.

Five themes will dominate investor thinking next week: the Bank of England's "Super Thursday" regarding interest rates and inflation; policy meetings for Australian and New Zealand central banks and China's monthly data release; expected growth in the U.S. trade deficit and a potential government shutdown; a gap in earnings growth expectations between European and U.S. equities; and various emerging market central bank rate-setting meetings.

The United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit affirmed a district court's grant of summary judgment in favor of the Village of Orland Park and three police department officials. Joseph McGreal, a former police officer, alleged he was fired in retaliation for protected speech at a community board meeting and claimed intentional infliction of emotional distress. The court found that McGreal provided no admissible evidence that the defendants knew of his speech or that their provided reasons for his termination—including misconduct and lying under oath—were pretextual. Additionally, the court ruled that McGreal failed to prove the defendants' conduct was extreme or outrageous or that he suffered severe emotional distress.

HoopTactics offers proven baseline, sideline, and full-court out-of-bounds plays designed to create high-percentage shots or flow into predetermined continuities. For full-court situations under pressure, the text recommends practicing, substituting best inbounders and shooters, and using baseline plays to safely inbound the ball. Advancing the ball to midcourt via a timeout is preferred for end-of-game scenarios.

The Colorado Rockies defeated the San Francisco Giants 11-4. Kyle Freeland pitched 5 1/3 innings and doubled, while every Rockies starter recorded a hit. The Giants lost two pitchers to injury: starter Jeff Samardzija left with shoulder tightness, and debutant Dereck Rodriguez was removed after being hit by a line drive. Evan Longoria hit two solo home runs for San Francisco.

Maddie Sabourin, an 18-year-old high school senior, is a kidney match for her grandfather, Sam Senseney, who has been on a transplant list for six years. After advocating for organ donation and convincing doctors to allow her to donate despite her age, Sabourin and Senseney are meeting with doctors to schedule surgery.

This disclosure describes enhanced mechanisms for implementing isolated network slices in 5G systems, specifically focusing on the selection of an Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF). It defines three levels of isolation: fully isolated (no shared (R)AN or core network functions), partly isolated with shared (R)AN, and partly isolated with shared (R)AN and AMF. Depending on the isolation level, the AMF may be selected by the Network Repository Function (NRF), Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF), or Unified Data Management (UDM) based on requested and subscribed network slice isolation information, S-NSSAI, and UE identifiers.

Using the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers from Trinity College Dublin analyzed the rogue planet SIMP-0136. They discovered strong auroral activity that heats the upper atmosphere, constant silicate clouds, and temperature changes suggestive of storms. The planet's temperature exceeds 1,500 °C.

The court affirmed a judgment ruling that a deed of gift from Louis Helbing to his wife, Louise, was not executed with the intent to defraud creditors. Although the deed remained unrecorded for over two years—allowing Helbing to obtain credit from W. W. Montague & Co. by representing himself as the owner—the court found the plaintiff failed to meet the burden of proving fraudulent intent at the time of the deed's execution. The court also ruled that the exclusion of testimony regarding the later concealment of personal property was insufficient to justify a reversal.

Tropical Storm Nate, the 15th system of a record-breaking Atlantic hurricane season, has caused 22 deaths in Latin America, including 15 in Nicaragua and seven in Costa Rica. Louisiana Governor John Bel Edwards declared a state of emergency and mobilized 1,300 National Guard troops as the storm is forecast to hit southeast Louisiana as a Category 1 hurricane.

The article tests a pair trading strategy involving SPY and TLT, where a long position in SPY and a short position in TLT are taken when both move significantly in opposite directions on the same day. Backtesting from 2003 to June 2021 showed the strategy was erratic, inconsistent, and not tradeable, regardless of changes to movement criteria or holding periods.

This retrospective, cross-sectional study analyzed factors causing delayed discharge (length of stay >15 days) for 390 adult patients at St James's Hospital's Complex Discharge Unit during the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic. Results showed a median LOS of 19.4 days, with 60.7% of patients experiencing delayed discharge. Key contributing factors included patient-centred needs, multimorbidity (>4 comorbidities), and age (specifically 65-75 years). Stratified COX regression identified complications from primary diagnoses and patient-centred needs as statistically significant factors prolonging LOS across various age and gender strata.

OpenAI is preparing to launch a TikTok-like social app for AI-generated videos powered by its Sora 2 model. The app features a vertical, swipe-to-scroll feed with a recommendation algorithm and options to like, comment, or remix videos.

The Warren Buffett ETF Portfolio (90/10) is a passive investment strategy involving the allocation of 90% of funds into low-cost S&P 500 index ETFs and 10% into government bonds. Inspired by Warren Buffett's philosophy, the strategy aims for long-term growth with lower fees and reduced risk compared to actively managed portfolios. While the S&P 500 provides equity exposure, government bonds act as a cushion against volatility. Backtests indicate that longer bond maturities generally offer higher compensation for risk, though past performance does not guarantee future results.

Bank of England research suggests a central bank digital currency (CBDC) could enhance monetary policy effectiveness. A CBDC paying interest could force commercial banks to adjust rates faster to retain deposits and improve quantitative easing by allowing the central bank to bypass the banking sector when purchasing assets. While the Bank is not currently planning to issue a CBDC, it is investigating designs to prevent commercial bank runs.

The Court of Appeals reversed a circuit court order and reinstated the dismissal of a child abandonment charge against Lawrence B. Schaub. Schaub had transferred his ten-month-old daughter to an undercover police officer for financial gain. The court determined that while evidence established Schaub's intent to wholly abandon the child, it did not establish the element of "exposure." Following the precedent in *Shannon v People*, the court held that exposure requires subjecting a child to a hazard of personal injury; because the child was handed directly to a person to care for her, she was not placed at risk. A dissenting opinion argued that delivering an infant to a stranger constitutes exposure and should have been a question of fact for a jury.

Consular reports indicate that 600 to 800 American citizens in Cuba, particularly in central and eastern rural districts, lack food and medicine. To provide relief and transportation for those wishing to return to the U.S., a recommended appropriation of at least $50,000 is requested for the Secretary of State.

The editor of *Foreign Relations, 1981–1988, Volume I* acknowledges assistance from the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, the Library of Congress, the CIA, and the Office of the Historian. Research was conducted under Adam M. Howard and reviewed by Kathleen B. Rasmussen. Documentation was sourced from public records, including presidential papers and Congressional reports, and classified materials from the Reagan Library, the papers of George P. Shultz, and Department of State files.

Walmart executive Greg Cathey announced that drone delivery will expand to most areas where the company operates, moving beyond small-scale tests. Partnering with Alphabet's Wing, Walmart has surpassed 300,000 deliveries and is expanding services to Northwest Arkansas and 100 stores across five cities. Cathey cited a favorable regulatory environment as a key factor in making drone delivery a viable part of Walmart's last-mile strategy.

The Golden Cross Trading Strategy uses a short-term moving average (typically 50-day) and a long-term moving average (typically 200-day). A buy signal occurs when the short-term average crosses above the long-term average, and a sell signal occurs when it crosses below. Designed to exploit long-term market uptrends and reduce bear market losses, a backtest of the S&P 500 since 1960 showed a 6.8% annual return with a 79% win rate and lower drawdowns than a buy-and-hold strategy.

A cross-sectional study of 424 HIV patients at Kibungo Referral Hospital in Rwanda found an antiretroviral therapy (ART) non-adherence rate of 13%. Multivariate analysis identified significant factors associated with non-adherence: age under 31, lack of tertiary education, experience of stigma, perceiving ART as ineffective, and failure to integrate medication into daily routines. Setting alarms as reminders showed no significant impact on adherence.

In *Milan v. Duckworth*, the United States District Court for the Northern District of Indiana granted summary judgment for the defendants. Plaintiff Richard A. Milan alleged constitutional violations under the Eighth and Fourteenth Amendments regarding the denial of visitation privileges at the Indiana State Prison. The court determined that the plaintiff failed to establish a protectable liberty interest in visitation, as prison regulations provided discretionary authority to deny such privileges. The court ruled that the defendants' failure to provide the denial in writing did not constitute a substantive constitutional violation.

E-learning is essential for business competitiveness, requiring a flexible governance model to provide strategic direction, manage risks, and allocate resources. An e-learning ecosystem integrates learning communities and enterprises via a learning management system, offering benefits like increased productivity and ROI. 

The authors propose an e-learning governance framework consisting of structures, processes, communications/relational mechanisms, and pedagogies/instructional designs. This framework is enhanced by Darking’s six dimensions of digital ecosystem governance. Additionally, the paper emphasizes information security governance to mitigate ICT risks and the necessity of trust and regulatory knowledge bases to support open-source, self-organizing e-learning environments.

This study aims to estimate the Burden of Disease (BoD) of COVID-19 in the Republic of Ireland from March 1, 2020, to February 28, 2021. Using publicly available data, the researchers employ the Disability-Adjusted-Life-Year (DALY) metric, which sums Years of Life Lost (YLL) and Years Lived with Disability (YLD). YLL is calculated using mortality data and GBD standard life tables, while YLD is based on five health states: asymptomatic, moderate, severe, critical, and post-acute consequences.

Explainable AI aims to increase transparency and trust in AI decision-making to optimize resources and mitigate safety risks. Key challenges include the lack of unified evaluation frameworks, poor computational efficiency for large models, and difficulties in practical application. To address these, a proposed framework uses Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) to control model behavior by detecting and adjusting specific concepts in latent space, allowing for precise output control while maintaining text fluency.

This disclosure describes a storage appliance that acts as a cloud cache for snapshots. To prevent the eviction of stable data blocks—which can delay restores—the appliance uses a snapshot manager to create synthetic baseline snapshots and refresh eviction state data. 

The system organizes snapshot metadata into key-value stores (inode, directory, and data map records) and stores snapshot data in files. It supports "forever incremental" configurations, where a baseline is followed by incremental updates. The snapshot manager can restore full snapshots or individual files by merging records from the target snapshot back to the baseline. It also performs snapshot reclamation by merging valid data from deleted snapshots into succeeding ones. 

To reduce stable data eviction, the manager creates synthetic baselines either by expanding metadata ownership to the most recent snapshot or by using a reverse incremental approach that transfers data to a persisting synthetic baseline. These processes update the eviction state data (e.g., timestamps or use counters) to ensure stable blocks remain cached.

New York City police are investigating a video of officers using a stun gun on Dailene Rosario, a pregnant 17-year-old. Rosario, charged with resisting arrest, second degree harassment, and disorderly conduct, allegedly shoved an officer during a response to a fight in a Bronx building. The NYPD stated the incident is under internal review.

The speaker discusses team dynamics, including goaltending changes between Martin and Ray Emery, and praises the leadership of Alfredsson, Phillips, and Redden. He notes the improvement of several players, specifically highlighting the two-way play of Mike Comrie and the shot-blocking leadership of Anton. He expresses respect for Brian Burke's management and reflects on his difficult decision to leave a previous organization. Looking ahead to a series against Anaheim, he emphasizes the importance of depth, smart early play, and the team's ability to make adjustments.

In *Shumye v. Felleke*, the court addressed cross-motions for summary judgment regarding the Defendant's financial obligations under a Form I-864 Affidavit of Support. The court ruled that a sponsor must maintain the immigrant at an annual income of at least 125% of the federal poverty level, analyzed on a year-by-year basis.

The court granted partial summary judgment for the Defendant for the years 2000, 2001, 2002, 2004, and 2005, as the Plaintiff conceded her income met the threshold. However, the court denied the Defendant's motion for 2003, 2006, and 2007, finding that divorce settlements and student loans do not count as income, while student grants and housing subsidies do.

The court denied the Plaintiff's motion for summary judgment because she failed to provide competent evidence establishing her exact income for the disputed years.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported total net sales of $30.4 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2016, and $59.5 billion for the first six months of 2016. Net income for these periods was $857 million and $1.37 billion, respectively. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and AWS. AWS showed the highest growth, with sales increasing 58% in Q2 2016. As of June 30, 2016, total assets were $65.1 billion and total stockholders' equity was $16.5 billion. The company is currently managing various legal proceedings regarding patent infringement and tax audits in the U.S. and Europe.

Asian shares consolidated Tuesday following three days of gains. Investors are monitoring upcoming Federal Reserve and European Central Bank meetings, with potential U.S. interest rate hikes and growth forecast revisions expected. Meanwhile, the euro remains steady against the dollar, and oil prices rose due to a North Sea pipeline shutdown.

This document provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 devices. It specifies that linear dimensions are in millimeters per ASME Y14.5M and that package thermal pads must be soldered to the printed circuit board. The text includes guidelines on vias, solder coverage, and stencil design, while noting that data is subject to change without notice. Additionally, it defines orderable information terms regarding product status, material types, RoHS values, and MSL ratings.

This study examines how time-delayed feedback affects multi-agent learning in normal-form games. The authors demonstrate that even small time delays cause Optimistic Follow the Regularized Leader (OFTRL) to suffer from $\Omega(\sqrt{T})$-regret and diverge from the Nash equilibrium, as shown in a Matching Pennies example.

To address this, the authors propose Weighted Optimistic Follow the Regularized Leader (WOFTRL), which weights optimistic predictions $n$ times. They prove that when the optimistic weight exceeds the time delay ($n = m + 1$), the algorithm achieves $O(1)$-regret and best-iterate convergence in poly-matrix zero-sum games. Experimental results across Matching Pennies, Sato’s game, and Rock-Paper-Scissors support these findings, showing that $n > m$ is necessary to recover performance and ensure convergence.

Molina Healthcare, Inc. specializes in government-sponsored health insurance, specifically Medicaid and dual-eligible populations. While facing risks such as medical cost inflation and policy changes, the company is described as a structurally profitable compounder trading at a discount.

The speaker outlines a new American foreign policy based on democratic values, human rights, and optimism. This approach includes five cardinal principles: reaffirming a commitment to human rights, reinforcing bonds among democracies, engaging the Soviet Union to halt the strategic arms race, seeking lasting peace in the Middle East, and reducing nuclear and conventional weapons proliferation. The goal is to create a framework of international cooperation that addresses global justice and equity.

A study in the journal Pediatrics involving over 5,000 US women found that parental obesity is linked to developmental delays in children by age 3. Children of obese mothers were nearly 70% more likely to fail fine motor skill tests, while those with obese fathers were 75% more likely to fail social competence measures. Children of extremely obese couples were nearly three times more likely to fail problem-solving tests. Researchers suggest parental weight may be a factor in screening for early interventional services.

The September 28, 2000, issue of VentureWire reports several major financial activities: Warburg Pincus closed a $2.5 billion international private equity fund, Primus Venture Partners raised $200 million, and Goldman Sachs launched GSVentures with $250 million. Other highlights include Hyperchip's $67 million Series C round, the resignation of Gear.com's president and 22 layoffs, and Sally Ride's resignation as president of Space.com. The issue also lists numerous smaller funding rounds, M&A activity involving Zoho and Band-X, and various executive and board appointments.

Drew Doughty reports feeling confident and playing better as the playoffs progress, having overcome early-season struggles and pressure related to his contract. He notes that his team is clicking and has overcome adversity by defeating the top three Western Conference teams. Doughty praises his goalie's performance and character, describes the upcoming series as a battle between two strong teams, and observes that the team's success has increased their recognition and popularity in Los Angeles.

The NVIDIA GA10x Ampere architecture introduces third-generation Tensor Cores with a Sparsity feature and TF32 precision to accelerate AI and data science. It features second-generation RT Cores that double ray/triangle intersection rates and include a new Interpolate Triangle Position unit for faster ray-traced motion blur. The architecture utilizes GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling for increased bandwidth, PCIe Gen 4 for faster host interface speeds, and third-generation NVLink for GPU-to-GPU connectivity. 

Additional innovations include RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression via Microsoft DirectStorage, and support for HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4a. The GA10x SM doubles FP32 processing rates compared to Turing. Hardware-accelerated video is handled by fifth-generation NVDEC, which introduces AV1 decode support, and seventh-generation NVENC. These advancements are implemented across products including the GeForce RTX 30-series, the RTX A6000 workstation GPU, and the A40 data center GPU.

Users can subscribe to documentation updates via ti.com and access support through TI E2E™ forums. Benjamin Graham defines investing as selecting securities that protect capital and promise adequate returns; otherwise, the purchase is speculation. To protect the downside, value investors buy financially solid companies with clean balance sheets at large discounts to their intrinsic value, creating a margin of safety. This approach allows for profit by avoiding big mistakes and buying unloved firms or those with temporary problems before the stock price returns to intrinsic value.

The Stack Zone Offense is a prolific, flexible system based on the overload principle, introduced by Mike Frink. This document provides a user-level description of the AGESA™ software interface for host environment wrapper implementers. It defines procedure call interfaces, recommended implementations, and build options, requiring knowledge of BIOS programming.

The software uses a three-level versioning scheme (X.Y.Z) and complies with UEFI C Coding Standards. It supports two build methods: binary modules (indirect) and source integration (integrated). The binary image model utilizes a dispatcher for entry points and a router for call-outs to the host BIOS, operating in 32-bit protected mode with flat addressing.

Key functional components include:
*   **Initialization Sequence:** Core entry points are based on the boot timeline, including `AmdInitReset` (minimal processor initialization), `AmdInitEarly` (full processor initialization), `AmdInitPost` (memory initialization), and `AmdInitLate` (late initialization and table generation).
*   **Memory Management:** The system uses "initializer" functions to pre-fill parameter structures. It provides tools for managing Cache-As-RAM (CAR) and establishing the stack environment via `AMD_ENABLE_UEFI_STACK`.
*   **Error Handling:** Errors are reported via return codes (ranging from `SUCCESS` to `FATAL`) and a circular event log buffer.
*   **UEFI Integration:** The software is organized into libraries for SEC, PEI, and DXE phases, utilizing specific PEIM modules for processor and memory initialization.

In *Hunter and Others v. Bales*, the Supreme Court affirmed a decree for specific performance of a real estate contract. Moore had entered into a verbal agreement to sell land to Thompson via an agent, later made a verbal agreement with Matthew R. Hunter, and subsequently executed a title bond to Thompson. Despite the bond, Moore deeded the land to Matthew Hunter, who had knowledge of the bond, before Matthew conveyed it to Moses Hunter. The court held that Thompson had the prior equity. Additionally, the court ruled that in specific performance suits, offering to bring liquidated money into court is sufficient tender, and a vendee is not chargeable with interest after tender unless the vendor proves the vendee used the money.

This study compared a syndromic PCR panel with a hybridization capture-based metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) workflow using 29 nasopharyngeal samples from individuals suspected of acute upper respiratory infections. While both methods showed high concordance for shared targets, mNGS identified 29 additional microorganisms, including pathogens like SARS-CoV-2, Coxsackievirus A, and HRV-C. The researchers used the Explify® Platform to phenotypically group these microorganisms by infectivity potential to assess their risk of trafficking to the lower respiratory tract. The results suggest that targeted hybridization-capture mNGS is a more comprehensive, cost-effective, and clinically relevant alternative to traditional PCR for detecting complex respiratory (co)infections.

The Florida Department of Transportation presented two plans to link the Sawgrass Expressway and I-95 via a Southwest 10th Street connector in Deerfield Beach. Intended to reduce rush hour congestion, the project involves depressed and partially covered roadways, though it faces opposition from local officials and residents.

A NOIPolls survey indicates that 88 percent of Nigerian doctors plan to migrate, primarily to the UK and US. This brain drain, driven by low satisfaction, poor pay, and high taxes, has worsened the physician-patient ratio to 1:5,000, far exceeding the WHO's 1:600 recommendation. Consequently, Nigeria faces increased fatalities and medical errors. While the country needs 303,000 doctors, only about 35,000 are currently practicing.

This study proposes a scalable architecture for the digitally structured exchange of technical information between industrial enterprises, specifically focusing on the lifecycle management of industrial plants. Current communication practices are largely manual, labor-intensive, and error-prone due to heterogeneous back-end systems and a lack of comprehensive standards.

The proposed architecture utilizes an open consortium to establish common business practices and information formats. Communication is facilitated by mediators acting as multi-sided platforms, which route information between business partners. To manage system heterogeneity, adapters map proprietary internal data to the agreed-upon common structures. A prototype demonstrated the practical value of this concept by successfully delivering equipment information from suppliers to plant operators for maintenance and renewal projects, reducing the need for manual data mapping.

In *Asa B. Meech v. The City of Buffalo*, the court addressed whether the city could legally levy a second assessment to pay for a sewer's construction after the original contract price proved insufficient. The contractor, Randolph, encountered unforeseen quicksand that significantly increased costs, leading him to stop work until additional compensation was granted. The city's common council agreed to an additional sum of $588.13 and directed a supplementary assessment on the benefited properties to cover the deficiency.

The plaintiffs challenged the second assessment as illegal, arguing the city was bound by the original contract and its security. However, the court held that the city had the power to modify the contract and that the charter specifically authorized "further assessments" if the initial amount was insufficient to defray expenses. The court concluded the supplementary assessment was valid and affirmed the judgment against the plaintiffs.

This case study investigated the experiences of Physical Education Teacher Education (PETE) students in a movement education course utilizing a peer mentoring learning ecosystem. Results indicated that peer learners developed communication and cooperation skills through group work, while peer mentors enhanced their accountability and professional responsibility. Additionally, the use of narrative content connected learning to daily life, increasing knowledge permanence and professional awareness. The study concludes that peer mentoring and interactive, non-traditional environments effectively prepare teacher candidates for their professional careers.

Version 2 of the specification introduces a 52-bit FEATURES bitmap for guests to request hypervisor feature support. Communication is managed via the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), which is 4K aligned and specified by the guest. The GHCB MSR protocol allows for protocol negotiation, SEV information requests, and CPUID register value retrieval before the GHCB is established.

The protocol supports various Non-Automatic Exits (NAE), including page state changes, SNP guest requests, and AP creation/destruction. For SEV-SNP guests, the Restricted Injection feature utilizes a #HV doorbell page for host notifications, using a "PendingEvent" field for interrupt vectors and non-maskable events, and a "NoEoiRequired" field for EOI assist. The hypervisor emulates APIC behavior, while the guest atomically exchanges values in the doorbell page to acknowledge interrupts and perform EOIs. Additionally, the specification defines mechanisms for Secure AVIC backing page management and guest termination requests.
